CODE
Art. 2.3.21. 
Re-investment 
Re-investment is deemed to have been made in respect of one of the spouses whenever, at the time of a real estate acquisition, he or she has declared that it was made in lieu of reinvestment and paid for to the extent of more than half, from the proceeds of the alienation of his or her own real estate or of funds the nature of which is duly established.
A spouse who acquires a property with joint funds may make a declaration of advance reinvestment in the deed. Provided the spouse repays, within two years of the date of the deed, more than half of the sums drawn from the joint assets, the property acquired will be considered to be his or her own property from the date of repayment.
Reimbursement is deemed to have been made in respect of a spouse where it is established that more than half of the acquisition of movable property was paid for with funds or with the proceeds of the alienation of other property the ownership of which is established in accordance with the provisions of Articles 2.3.17 to 2.3.20.
